verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AYI Katonda waffe
Ggwe watonda ffe,
Naye twakuvaako
Dda,ne twonoona.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ayi Katonda waffe,
Twakujeemera;
Naye tukusinza
Tuli baana bo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ayi Katonda waffe,
Watusaasira;
Twebaze ggwe leero,
Olw'okutwagala.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ayi Mukama waffe.
watununula;
Twagala-okukusenga
Tukuweereze.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ayi Mukama waffe,
Twali bajeemu;
Naye otusenze,
Tube-abaddu bo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ayi Katonda-,Omwoyo
Omutukuvu,
Fenna otukuume,
Leero mu bibi.
